guard: software updates reach their own continuity checks without refreshing account catalogues
why: The real registered update metadata passes through the dispatcher against an expired selected account. Reverting only the opt-out must fail the named routing assertion before the updater observer runs. This regression is a routing check; full-update terminal replays are separate.

mutations.name: restore account catalogue preparation before update
mutations.expectRed: update dispatch reaches its own continuity checks without catalogue authentication
mutations.cell: update dispatch reaches its own continuity checks without catalogue authentication
